description: Use when you need native and stablecoin balances for a list of wallets: up to 25 addresses (0x or ENS names) in one POST. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (POST /wallet/balance/batch, $0.075 per call; schema linked). POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For one wallet use wallet_balance. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price.

chains.description: Optional comma list applied to every address (ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon); default all EVM chains
